name: habit-chain-worker
description: habit-chain — 전면 HTMX. 화면 렌더링 + DoltHub 읽기/쓰기

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R ../web/. dist/ && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/_worker.js
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev --port 8788
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy
